observations: Acknowledgements beyond contiguous captured bytes at: none.
limitations: Repeated bytes can reflect retransmission or duplicate capture; they do not prove packet loss or locate its cause. Acknowledged unseen bytes show incomplete observation, not that those bytes were lost in transit.

The acknowledgement-to-response interval includes endpoint work and transport effects; it is not a pure application-delay or round-trip-time measurement. Reset origin and capture completeness need separate evidence.
